Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Intro Paragraph 1: This first on-screen meeting of minds between Stellium7 and Slick Dissident is sure to set off some synchronistic fireworks. Mike Wilkerson (Stellium7 on Youtube) has uncovered incredible mysterious in stone, including evidence of possible titanic-sized ancient bodies, petrified as modern mountains and rock formations. Tune in for some good old-fashioned free-weaving, vibe ranting, philo-sophic fun.
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "It sounds like you're taking a page out of the same book that I'm working through right now, which is quality over quantity.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Wait a minute, I've lived inside of these things, and then when I added up the different places that I lived, I've lived inside of seven different star forts in my life.", "author": "Stellium7", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "It actually progresses across the heavens just like an actor on a stage performing glorious feats on a massive scale above everybody's head.", "author": "Slick Dissident", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "How is this going to form banging around with other rocks in a river bottom, and how do you have so many that are almost the same, they're identical?", "author": "Stellium7", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "The medicine of the animal called elephant is to help us remember, like before our cycle or before our life.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I often joke that when it all is boiled down that science is really the art of apologizing for how wrong you were.", "author": "Slick Dissident", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "I think volcanoes are former trees, that's my theory.", "author": "Stellium7", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "I got busted as a hacker back in 1985 and I infiltrated Microsoft and Boeing and Sunstrand and Kenworth Trucking and a whole bunch of other companies.", "author": "Stellium7", "portrait": ""}]
